cases.description: npm package-lock.json lockfileVersion 3 with direct lodash 4.17.15 (CVE-2020-8203, CVE-2019-10744), rc 1.2.8 pulling transitive minimist 1.2.0 (CVE-2020-7598), and dev-only chalk chain.
cases.notes: Full nested dep graph (rc -> deep-extend/ini/minimist/strip-json-comments, chalk -> ansi-styles/escape-string-regexp/supports-color -> has-flag/color-convert) so dependency edges exist for directness comparison.

cases.description: Yarn classic (v1) yarn.lock with lodash 4.17.15 and the same rc/minimist plus chalk dev chain as the npm case.
cases.notes: Same package universe as npm-package-lock-basic; per-entry dependencies blocks produce edges.

cases.description: Yarn Berry yarn.lock (__metadata header, resolution:/checksum:/languageName:) with lodash 4.17.15 and the same legacy graph.
cases.notes: Berry-style keys ('name@npm:range') and hex checksums; per-entry dependencies blocks produce edges.

cases.description: pnpm-lock.yaml lockfileVersion 6.0 with devDependencies (chalk chain) and optionalDependencies (fsevents 2.3.2) alongside the lodash/rc production set.
cases.notes: importers section + /name@version packages entries; flat version pins in dependency maps carry edges.

cases.description: Flat requirements.txt pinned to django==3.0 (multiple known CVEs), requests==2.19.0 era stack including urllib3==1.24.2.
cases.notes: requirements.txt carries no dependency edges by design; requests transitive deps listed explicitly as pins.

cases.description: Modern poetry.lock ([[package]] array-of-tables with [package.dependencies]) pinning django 3.0 and markupsafe 2.0.1; pyproject.toml sibling included for realism.
cases.notes: django -> pytz/sqlparse [package.dependencies] entries produce edges; pyproject.toml is not an inventory input for hooray.

cases.description: Pipfile.lock with _meta.hash.sha256, default section (jinja2 2.11.3, CVE-2020-28493 era) and develop section (pytest 6.2.5).
cases.notes: Pipfile.lock records hashes only, no dependency graph.

cases.description: Gemfile.lock GEM/specs with rails 6.0.0 (CVE-2022-21831 era), nokogiri 1.10.10 and a consistent actionpack/activesupport/railties/rack graph.
cases.notes: hooray emits both specs entries and their referenced dependency rows as components (hence 17); ecosystem string is 'gem'.

cases.description: Package.resolved version 2 pins array with legacy swift-nio 2.20.0 and swift-collections 0.0.4 remoteSourceControl pins.
cases.notes: Flat pin list; no edges available from Package.resolved.

cases.description: pubspec.lock with sdks section, yaml 2.2.1 direct main pin, http 0.12.2, one direct dev dep (pedantic 1.11.1) and transitive http_parser/path/async.
cases.notes: Ecosystem string is 'pub'; hosted-source descriptions in old style (name+url, no sha256).

cases.description: Podfile.lock PODS/DEPENDENCIES/SPEC CHECKSUMS sections with AFNetworking 3.2.1 and SDWebImage 4.4.8 -> FLAnimatedImage 1.2.0.
cases.notes: Ecosystem string is 'cocoapods'.

cases.description: composer.json require/require-dev with guzzlehttp/guzzle 6.5.0 exact pin, symfony/console ^4.4 range constraint and phpunit ^8.5 dev constraint.
cases.notes: EXPECTED QUIRK: composer.json stores constraints and hooray records them as Component.version; range constraints (^4.4, ^8.5, >=7.2.5) therefore yield VERSIONLESS purls while the exact 6.5.0 pin yields pkg:composer/guzzlehttp/guzzle@6.5.0. The php platform package is not emitted.

cases.description: environment.yml name/channels/prefix with pinned legacy conda packages (urllib3 1.25.9, jinja2 2.11.3) and a pip subsection pinning requests==2.22.0.
cases.notes: pip subsection components are emitted as pypi; conda entries as conda.

cases.description: Chart.yaml apiVersion v2 with dependencies[] carrying repository/version/condition/tags for bitnami postgresql 9.8.0 and redis 10.5.7.
Cargo.lock version 3 with a small registry graph demo-crate -> dep-a 1.0.0 -> dep-b 0.2.1 -> dep-c 0.4.2; Cargo.toml sibling declares the root crate license (MIT OR Apache-2.0).
cases.notes: [[package]] blocks produce [[package]].dependencies edges; Cargo.toml sidecar exercises the license inheritance path.

cases.description: go.mod with module/go/toolchain directives and require block pinning golang.org/x/crypto v0.0.0-20190308221718-c2843e01e9fb pseudo-version (CVE-2020-9283/9288 window) and github.com/pkg/errors v0.9.1; go.sum sibling included.
cases.notes: go.sum is hashed as a sidecar but must NOT emit packages; component count equals go.mod require count exactly.

cases.description: packages.lock.json for .NETCoreApp v3.1 with Direct Castle.Windsor 5.0.0 -> Transitive Castle.Core 4.4.0, Serilog.Sinks.File 3.1.1 -> Serilog 2.9.0, and Direct Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.3.
cases.notes: type Direct/Transitive plus per-package dependencies maps give real edges.

cases.description: CycloneDX 1.6 bom.cdx.json adapted from the official CycloneDX 1.6 example (see UPSTREAM): metadata.component root plus lodash 4.17.15 (MIT expression license), minimist 1.2.0, django 3.0, all with versioned purls and a dependencies[] graph.
cases.notes: Versioned purls required on every component or the scan aborts. Declared edges between collected COMPONENTS are recorded (lodash -> minimist); dependsOn entries naming only metadata.component are dropped by hooray's refs map, so the fixture keeps a component-to-component edge.

cases.description: SPDX-2.3 doc.spdx.json with spdxVersion SPDX-2.3, three packages carrying versionInfo and versioned purl externalRefs, one DESCRIBES and resolving DEPENDS_ON relationships.
cases.notes: Unversioned purl externalRefs fail closed (InvalidComponent); observed DEPENDS_ON relationships produce two real dependency edges, so directness comparison applies.

cases.description: Deterministically built project.zip containing a simplified package-lock.json (lodash 4.17.15, rc 1.2.8 -> minimist 1.2.0) from the same content family as npm-package-lock-basic.
cases.notes: Scan via 'scan artifact'; zip members route through the same virtual-file lockfile dispatch as directories.

cases.description: Single-package Cargo project (license-files-project 0.1.0, no declared license) with LICENSE (MIT text) and COPYING (BSD-2-Clause text) files.
cases.notes: Detected license files attribute only to the unlicensed asset-named component (license.rs asset_component contract), so the package name must equal the directory name. Expect two detected license findings with case-relative paths.
